excerpt.zh: 由于[Root.GetName]的前任指挥官意外身亡，[marauder_species.GetNamePlural]派遣指挥官[new_leader.GetName]接替前任指挥官的职务。
excerpt.en: Following the untimely demise of the former commander of the [Root.GetName], the [marauder_species.GetNamePlural] have dispatched Commander [new_leader.GetName] as a replacement.
